summary: Intel Corp filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered debt offering of $6.5 billion aggregate principal amount across five tranches of senior unsecured notes maturing from 2031 to 2066. The notes are not listed on any exchange, are senior unsecured obligations ranking equally with existing debt, and have no sinking fund. Proceeds from the offering will be used for general corporate purposes. Underwriters include Citigroup, J.P. Morgan, Barclays, and others. The offering is a routine capital markets transaction, not a special situation event. Risk-arb angle: none, as this is a standard debt issuance.
